title: Not Ready to Go Home

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca
sources.note: User-supplied fingerprinted EPUB, SEVEN: A Little Delusional. From Hannah’s six-month absence through Jeremy’s quiet check-in and the final writing class; ends as Alden reaches Gorgon’s desk before the private conversation. Simplified Mandarin and reflective rejoining choices; watch-only silent adaptation.

notice: This episode adapts Super Supportive by Sleyca. Conversations are simplified for Mandarin reading, and choices vary your response while preserving the story’s events.
